name: ligne
description: Metro-map lines, stations and zones drawn over Excalidraw: web page + Obsidian plugin.

scripts.release: npm run build && rm -rf release && mkdir -p release/ligne && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css release/ligne/ && cd release && zip -qr ligne.zip ligne && echo release/ligne.zip
scripts.version: node tools/version.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
